Description: Shows successful login activity for a specified user, including source and destination systems. Useful for access investigations and account activity reviews.
SPL: | tstats count from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication where Authentication.user="<insert user name here>" AND Authentication.action=success by _time Authentication.src Authentication.dest`

Description: Displays account modification activity for a specified user, including actions performed, change type, status, and the system reporting the change. Useful for investigating account changes, lockouts, password resets, and administrative actions.
SPL: | tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel="Change" where All_Changes.object_id="<insert username here>" by All_Changes.user All_Changes.action All_Changes.change_type All_Changes.result All_Changes.object All_Changes.object_category All_Changes.object_id All_Changes.status All_Changes.vendor_product _time`

Description: Identifies users receiving blocked emails. Useful for investigating phishing attempts, spam campaigns, and email security enforcement.
SPL: | tstats summariesonly=t count(All_Email.action) from datamodel=Email.All_Email where All_Email.action="blocked" by All_Email.recipient`

Description: Summarizes malware detections by signature and identifies affected systems and users. Useful for identifying widespread infections and malware trends.
SPL: | tstats summariesonly=true dc(Malware_Attacks.dest) as system_count values(Malware_Attacks.dest) as affected_systems values(Malware_Attacks.user) as users_affected from datamodel=Malware.Malware_Attacks by Malware_Attacks.signature`

Description: Shows network communications to a specified destination IP, including source IPs, ports, and protocols. Useful for investigating suspicious communications and external connections.
SPL: | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_ip="insert destination IP here" by All_Traffic.src_ip All_Traffic.dest_ip All_Traffic.dest_port All_Traffic.transport`

Description: Identifies the number of unique hosts impacted by a specific CVE. Useful for measuring organizational exposure and remediation progress.
SPL: | tstats summariesonly=t dc(Vulnerabilities.dest) as "Affected Hosts" from datamodel=Vulnerabilities.Vulnerabilities where Vulnerabilities.cve="example CVE"`

Description: Lists vulnerabilities detected on a specific host grouped by severity. Useful for host-level vulnerability reviews and remediation planning.
SPL: | tstats summariesonly=t values(Vulnerabilities.signature) from datamodel=Vulnerabilities.Vulnerabilities H8:K12where Vulnerabilities.dest="insert hostname" by Vulnerabilities.severity | sort +Vulnerabilities.severity`

Description: Searches web activity for a specified URL and identifies matching events. Useful for investigating user access to suspicious or malicious websites.
SPL: | tstats count(Web.url) as url_count values(Web.url) as URL from datamodel=Web where Web.url="" by index`
